div.head: Northu 9
div.ab: Gif preost to rihtes timan crisman ne fecce, gilde XII ór.
Gif preost to rihtes timan crisman ne fecce, gilde XII or.
Wenn ein Priester das Chrisma nicht zur Gesetzeszeit [vom Bischof] holt, zahle er 12 Ör.
If a priest does not fetch the chrism [from the bishop] at the lawful time, let him pay 12 ores.
If a priest does not fetch the chrism at the proper time, he is to pay 12 ores.
If a priest does not fetch the chrism at the right time, he is to pay twelve oras.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.

note.seg: Die Quelle las andaga, welches Wort auch I As 1 in jüngerer Hs. durch ein ‘Zeit’ bedeutendes ersetzt wird.—S. Gl Salböl
The source read andaga, a word which in I As 1 too is replaced in a later MS by one meaning ‘time’. — See Gl Salböl
